Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and exec briefing timing

Camila —

Thanks for the MAP draft. Tom and I reviewed and have a couple of asks before we lock the EB (executive briefing) slot:

- Can Redwood commit to a SOC2 evidence drop by next Wednesday (7/28)? Procurement wants an initial artifacts bundle.
- We need the EB to include a focused 20-minute ROI/ops slot and a 30-minute Q&A with our CTO. Can you map who from Redwood will be there?

Attaching the procurement intake so you can see the gating items. We’re under a compressed evaluation timeline — target buyer decision week of 8/2.

Best,

Nimbus Health

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Alicia — thanks for the quick review. High level response and proposed next steps below.

Short answers:
- SOC2 artifacts: yes — we’ll provide an initial bundle (system descriptions, control matrix, sample audit logs) by EOD 7/28. I’ve flagged this as critical on the MAP.
- EB attendees: propose the following lineup for the 60-minute EB you requested:
  * Marissa Cole — Sales Director (strategic framing / exec sponsor) — 10m
  * Ben Carter — Account Exec (commercials / win criteria) — 10m
  * Karthik Iyer — Solutions Engineer (architecture/ops deep dive) — 30m (including CTO q&a)
  * Myself — customer success handoff & next steps — 10m

Proposed MAP updates: I attached a refreshed MAP (Nimbus-MAP-v2.xlsx) with milestones and owners, including SOC2 artifact delivery (7/28), pilot data ingest (7/29–8/1), EB firming (target 7/30–8/1), and decision week (8/2).

Can you confirm Alicia/Tom which EB window works best:
- Option A: Fri 7/30 09:00–10:00 PT
- Option B: Mon 8/02 11:00–12:00 PT (note: this is during decision week)

I’ll mark both tentative on our side until you confirm.

Thanks — cami
Camila Reyes
Sr. Partner Manager, Redwood Inference

Camila / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attendee slate. Option A (Fri 7/30 09:00–10:00 PT) looks best for us — gives time to surface any last-minute security items before decision week. Please treat the date as primary for now.

One additional request from our CTO during readout: a short latency / cost-per-inference slide with expected throughput for our 50k monthly user profile. Could Karthik include that in the ops deep dive?

Also procurement will still want to see the initial SOC2 bundle on 7/28 — Alicia, we’ll coordinate internally but that’s the gating ask.

Team — quick operational update and prep checklist for the EB (Fri 7/30). Adding for visibility and action.

Prep checklist (owners):
- SOC2 artifacts: cami / security ops — deliver sample bundle by 7/28 EOD (camila = owner).
- EB deck: Ben to drop draft slide deck in shared Drive by 7/29 12:00 PT (owner: ben_carter).
- Latency/cost slide: karthik_iyer to include the 50k-user throughput profile + two config options (batched vs low-latency) by 7/29 16:00 PT.
- Pilot ingest window confirmation: cami to confirm whether we can start ingest on 7/29 or if Nimbus prefers 7/30.
- Decision criteria: Marissa to finalize win criteria and threshold for PO signature (target: revenue, SLOs, onboarding timeline).

I’ll build the EB run-of-show: 10m exec framing (marissa), 10m business/value (ben), 30m ops & CTO q&a (karthik), 10m next steps/MAP cadence (cami).

I’m tentatively reserving 09:00–10:00 PT on Fri 7/30 on all internal calendars; please decline if unavailable.

—Ben

Account Executive, Redwood Inference
